title: 第3698章 诡异寺庙第3697章 古坟镇
lines: 来到镇子里，眼中看到的景象，让李总旗心惊，哇凉哇凉的。
拱门后的长街笔直地向前延伸，两旁的屋舍鳞次栉比，檐角挂着一排排晶莹的冰凌，在灰白的天光里泛着冷冷的亮。
之前在外面，虽然是登高俯瞰，可由于镇子阴气覆盖，加上建筑遮挡，看到的极其有限。
如今来到了镇子里面，才知道，镇子里面竟有这么多的人。
街道上的人流虽然远不及以往正常时候，但也不算很少。
有人挑着担子从身边经过，扁担两头挂着的竹筐里，青菜叶子绿得鲜亮，上面还沾着水珠。
有人蹲在自家门槛上抽着旱烟，眯着眼吐出一口白雾，和天上的雪混在一起分不清。
按照这个密度推测，加上屋子里面没有出来的。
古坟镇，如今恐怕有好几千人。
没有术法加持的双眼，看到的景象，真是一片祥和。
街上卖菜的，支摊的小贩，各种叫卖声此起彼伏。
卖糖葫芦的扛着草靶子在人群里穿行，红艳艳的山楂裹着晶亮的糖衣，在雪光里格外醒目。
卖糖人的老头手巧，铜勺里的糖浆在他腕间轻轻一抖，便拉出一条细长的丝，飞快地勾勒出飞禽走兽的模样。
卖首饰的摊子上，银簪铜镯摆了一排，晃出细碎的光斑。
酒楼门前揽客的小二，肩上搭着白巾，笑脸迎人，嗓音清亮。
凡俗百态，尽在其中，看起来好不热闹。
根本无法将这样的场景与之前看到的真实景象联系起来。
“李总旗，你好啊。
今日怎么来我们古坟镇了。
距离上次您来我们这里，都大半年了吧？
不会是我们镇子又出什么妖邪诡异了吧？”
有人上前来与李总旗打招呼，十分的热情，满脸洋溢着笑容。
那人穿一件灰布棉袄，袖口磨得起了毛边，脸上堆着褶子，眼睛弯成了两道月牙。
他的声音洪亮而热忱，像是见了久别重逢的老友。
李总旗脸上的肌肉微微抽搐了一下。
他心中有种说不出的膈应。
眼前这些看起来笑得灿烂的百姓，实际上都是假象。
这不是真实的画面，亦不是他们真实模样。
他们真实的模样是面色苍白，双眼空洞无神，嘴角扯着诡异的笑容。
李总旗装模作样回应了几句，便急忙离开。
他此刻一点都不想与这里的百姓靠近。
主要是心理上确实有障碍。
眼睛看到的全是假象。
实际情况，没有了高深造诣术法的加持，看不到。
尽管知道这些村民早已是行尸走肉，可这样近距离接触，却不知道他们此时究竟是个怎样的状态。
没走多远，他看到从外地来的武夫。
不是今日遇到的那批。
今日遇到的那批，还在他们后面，有些距离，而是以往进来的那些。
那些武夫，倚靠在街边巷道的转角处，正看着来来往往的人群。
他们身上落了一层薄雪，眉眼间带着长途跋涉的疲惫，但目光却清醒而警惕，不像镇民那样浑浑噩噩。
李总旗心中微动，就准备上前询问。
只因，这几个武夫，是他之前在山峦上俯瞰时，看到的极少数神情模样都正常的。
content_en:
When he came to the town, what he saw made Mr. Li Qi frightened and chilled.
The long street behind the arch extends straight forward, with rows of houses on both sides, and rows of crystal ice hanging from the eaves, glowing coldly in the gray sky.
Before, even though we were outside and had a bird's-eye view from a high place, what we could see was extremely limited due to the Yin Qi covering the town and the obstruction of the buildings.
Now that I came to the town, I realized that there were so many people in the town.
Although the flow of people on the streets is far less than normal, it is not very small either.
Someone was passing by carrying a burden. In the bamboo baskets hanging on both ends of the pole, the leaves of vegetables were bright green with water drops on them.
Someone was squatting on the threshold of his house, smoking a dry cigarette, squinting his eyes and spitting out a mouthful of white mist, which was mixed with the snow in the sky and was indistinguishable.
It is estimated based on this density, plus there is no one coming out of the house.
There are probably several thousand people in Tufun Town now.
The sight seen through eyes without the blessing of magic is truly peaceful.
Vegetable sellers and vendors set up stalls on the street, and all kinds of cries came one after another.
The candied haws sellers walked through the crowd carrying straw targets. The bright red hawthorns were wrapped in shiny sugar coating and stood out in the snowy light.
The old man who sold the candy was so skillful that he flicked the syrup in the copper spoon between his wrists and pulled out a slender thread, quickly outlining the appearance of birds and animals.
On the stall selling jewelry, silver hairpins and copper bracelets were arranged in a row, emitting tiny spots of light.
The waiter who greets customers in front of the restaurant has a white scarf on his shoulders, a smiling face and a clear voice.
All kinds of mundane things are there, and it looks so lively.
There was no way to connect this scene with the real thing I had seen before.
"Mr. Li Qi, hello.
Why did you come to our Tufun Town today?
It’s been more than half a year since you last came to our place, right?
Isn't there something weird happening in our town? "
Someone came up to greet Mr. Li Qi with great enthusiasm and a smile on his face.
The man wore a gray cotton-padded jacket, with frayed cuffs, wrinkles on his face, and eyes bent into two crescents.
His voice was loud and enthusiastic, like an old friend reunited after a long separation.
The muscles on Mr. Li's face twitched slightly.
There was an indescribable feeling in his heart.
The people who seem to be smiling brightly in front of them are actually all illusions.
This is not a real picture, nor is it what they really look like.
Their true appearance is that their faces are pale, their eyes are empty and lifeless, and they have weird smiles on their lips.
Mr. Li Qi pretended to respond with a few words and left in a hurry.
He doesn't want to get close to the people here at all at this moment.
Mainly because of the psychological barriers.
All the eyes see are illusions.
The actual situation cannot be seen without the blessing of profound attainments.
Although I knew that these villagers were already walking corpses, I didn't know what kind of state they were in after such close contact.
Not far away, he saw a martial artist from other places.
Not the group we encountered today.
The group they encountered today were still behind them, some distance away, but they were the ones who had come in in the past.
Those warriors were leaning on the corners of the streets and alleys, watching the people coming and going.
A thin layer of snow fell on their bodies, and their brows and eyes showed the fatigue of a long journey, but their eyes were clear and alert, not as confused as the townspeople.
Mr. Li Qi's heart moved slightly and he was about to step forward to ask.
It was simply because these warriors were among the very few he had seen with normal expressions when he was overlooking them from the mountains.
